title: Text: DET David Chadd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What's up with Wood's right hand?
Questioned “What's up with Wood's right hand? ”
Should I ask Al about Wood? It seems like it's a small thing - I don't even need to put it out there - but it's weird you won't answer about it!
Nothing weird about it! It's the Beleichick rule Al answers all medical questions!
I don't really want to bug Al about something like this if it's minor in nature, Wood is a minor league guy, it's the first day of spring
So should I ask Al about it?
When are u coming to camp
